title: Outpatient Cost-Share Basis and Percentages - TRICARE Select Tier Table
content:
Outpatient care under **TRICARE Select** is cost-shared, after the deductible, either as a percentage of the allowed amount or as a fixed network copayment. The network basis, the network and non-network percentages and the durable medical equipment percentage are fixed per tier.

## Tier table

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network outpatient basis | percent of allowed | percent of allowed | fixed copayment | fixed copayment | percent of allowed | fixed copayment |
| Network outpatient cost share (percent of the allowed amount after the deductible) | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 20 | 0 |
| Non-network outpatient cost share (percent of the allowed amount after the deductible) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 25 | 25 |
| Network durable medical equipment (percent of the allowed amount) | 15 | 15 | 10 | 10 | 20 | 20 |

## Notes on the table

- The **percent of allowed** basis belongs to the Group A tiers (TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group A); the **fixed copayment** basis belongs to the Group B tiers. On a fixed-copayment tier the network percentage is shown as 0 because the network copayment for the service class applies instead.
- Durable medical equipment in the network is always a percentage, on every tier; on the percent-of-allowed tiers its percentage equals the network outpatient percentage (15 and 20).
- The non-network percentage applies to participating and nonparticipating non-network providers alike.

## Hypothetical figures

A network outpatient line with an allowed amount of 200.00, after a deductible of 50.00, leaves 150.00 to cost-share. At 15 percent (TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A tiers) the cost share is 22.50; at 20 percent (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A) it is 30.00. The same line from a non-network provider at 25 percent (either retiree tier) carries 37.50.
